card.name: Gaps before numbers and poly- words
card.fires_on: Spaces or slashes just before a number in dose or content phrases, and the start of poly- or polyox- chemical names in compatibility or ingredient text. The pole is strongly negative on these.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank token right before a number in schedules or contents, such as every N weeks or contains N mg.
modes.example: prior to initiating LUTATHERA. ( 2.1 ) Administer 7.4 GBq (200 mCi) every<< >>8 weeks (± 1 week)

modes.label: Start of poly- names
modes.description: The poly part of plastic or excipient names such as polyolefin or polypropylene in compatibility statements.
modes.example: 6°F) for up to 8 hours, if not used immediately. No incompatibilities between Avastin and polyvinylchloride or<< poly>>olefin bags

modes.label: Slash or point in strengths
modes.description: A slash or decimal point inside paired strengths like 2 mg/0.5 mg.
modes.example: ual film unit dimensions Buprenorphine Concentration % (w/w) Naloxone Concentration % (w/w) 2 mg<</>>0.5 mg 8.8

card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a dose number or at the start of poly- material names in label text.
